summary_en: Completion of acquisition of all equity interests in Framochem Francia-Magyar Finomkemiai Kft (Hungary-based fine chemicals company). Quota purchase agreement signed 27 Mar 2026; closing completed 25 Aug 2026. Target becomes wholly owned subsidiary. Financial impact on FY3/27 results under review.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Acquisition of Equity Interests in Framochem Francia-Magyar Finomkemiai Kft (Making it a Wholly Owned Subsidiary)
translation_en_brief: Hodogaya Chemical Co., Ltd. announced on 26 August 2026 the completion of its acquisition of all equity interests in Framochem Francia-Magyar Finomkemiai Kft, a Hungary-based fine chemicals company. The company had previously disclosed this transaction on 27 March 2026 when it executed a Quota Purchase Agreement (equity purchase agreement) to acquire all ownership interests and make Framochem a wholly owned subsidiary. The closing occurred on 25 August 2026 as planned. With this transaction complete, Framochem is now consolidated into Hodogaya's group and operations have commenced under the new integrated structure, combining Hodogaya's domestic technical DNA with Framochem's leading European expertise for development of new value in global markets. The company noted that the financial impact on consolidated results for the fiscal year ending March 2027 is currently under review and will be disclosed when material changes to earnings forecasts are confirmed.
